name: Levi McConaughey
bio: Levi Alves McConaughey (born on July 7, 2008) is the eldest son of American actor Matthew McConaughey and his wife, Brazilian model Camila Alves.

credits.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
credits.overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

credits.title: The Lost Bus
credits.overview: A determined father risks everything to rescue a dedicated teacher and her students from a raging wildfire.
